open_issues: O4 MATCHES BY ID, s140's MapAnim BY NAME: a Zidane player entry registers CHRFX 16-19 on WALK/RUN-class ids other than 25/38 -- 190 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_WALK (2 ops, codes {19: 2}, frames16 {}, fields [2930]); 203 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_RUN (2 ops, codes {19: 2}, frames16 {}, fields [2930]); 2575 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_COLD_WALK (6 ops, codes {16: 2, 17: 2, 18: 2}, frames16 {'10': 1, '19': 1}, fields [307]); 3508 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_SWORD_RUN (18 ops, codes {16: 6, 17: 6, 18: 6}, frames16 {'0': 3, '9': 3}, fields [62, 63, 64]); 3521 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_SWORD_WALK (18 ops, codes {16: 6, 17: 6, 18: 6}, frames16 {'4': 3, '13': 3}, fields [62, 63, 64]); 4001 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_POT_WALK (54 ops, codes {16: 18, 17: 18, 18: 18}, frames16 {'14': 9, '3': 6, '4': 3}, fields [1606, 1607, 2513]); 7935 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_MBG_RUN (12 ops, codes {16: 4, 17: 4, 18: 4}, frames16 {'1': 2, 'computed': 2}, fields [1464, 1554]); 8555 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_TKE_WALK (6 ops, codes {16: 2, 17: 2, 18: 2}, frames16 {'4': 1, 'computed': 1}, fields [2802]); 8847 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_FRA_WALK (3 ops, codes {16: 1, 17: 1, 18: 1}, frames16 {'11': 1}, fields [2928]). Each PASSES unmapped while the dressed body plays rig.walk/run (evt.anim = the rig id), so the dressed body walks SILENTLY in those fields (incl. the disc-1 opening 62-64, SWORD_WALK/RUN). Cosmetic; extending O4 to the loco CLASS would need each variant's own frame pair (listed) -> the rig's pair. Recommend KNOWN in the README unless the engine stage widens the key.
gesture-class footstep keys on Zidane players pass as designed (steps_passed): 2630 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_KANGAERU (6 ops, fields [201]); 2713 ANH_MAIN_F0_ZDN_MATCH3 (18 ops, fields [50])

EMPTY-TABLE THROW (O4 as written): field 2930 Zidane_Init (entry 3, first in Main_Init's InitObject order [3, 2, 5, 6, 7, 4, 9, 8, 10]) registers 16-18 on 25/38 then runs code 19 on the ALIAS ids 190/203 (a stock no-op: no record has those ids). On a DROP rig (5 quina, 8 moogle, 9 cinna) the 16-18 are dropped and the 19s PASS, so if no other body has registered yet stock DeleteChar indexes charSoundArray[-1] (FF9Snd.cs DeleteChar) and throws inside the VM -- stock itself never faults there (no fault). Fix that keeps stock semantics: MapFootstep DROPS (counts) a code 19 whose (anim', frame') has NO record in the table -- stock's DeleteChar is a no-op then except for that throw. (Init order across entries is a runtime fact: PLAUSIBLE, not proven.)

F2 / F2c's 'no code-19 fault' CANNOT FAIL on field 250: its player entry runs no code 19 at all (only 16/17/18 x4 keys, at load and at Main_Reinit). To make the 19-drop checkable, the bench needs a synthetic RunModelCode(19, 25, 4, 0) on the dressed drop-rig body (e.g. the 30606 caller after the dress): s141 drops it (steps_dropped 12 -> 13, steps stays [], no fault); under `polish off` the table holds the 4 UNMAPPED Zidane records, so the 19 matches (25, 4) and stock DeleteChar's charSoundUse-- drops the TOP record (steps 4 -> 3 rows, steps_dropped 0) -- the calibration red. Only an EMPTY table makes a passed 19 throw (see the field-2930 row).

O4's sound override must touch codes 16 and 17 only (sndEffectID[0]/[1], the 'both slots'); code 18's Arg4 is the random-pitch FLAG (fldchar.cs: pitchRand = Arg4 == 0 ? 0 : 1) and 19 ignores Arg4. Every stock code-18 Arg4 on 25/38 and on Steiner's 1996/2005 is 1, so the difference is invisible in stock data; the twin (map_footstep) and its 'sound_on_18' mutant pin the 16/17-only reading.
